summary: Fixed 2 bugs in parentDocId fallback recall logic (lines 586-623). Bug 1: SQL query was using `WHERE session_id = ? AND rowid != ?` (sibling lookup) instead of `WHERE uid = ?` (parent lookup). Bug 2: `continue` skipped source-addition logic (token estimation, overflow check, push to sources) — replaced with full pattern matching DERIVED_FROM parent behavior.

bug1.old: `SELECT rowid FROM node WHERE session_id = ? AND rowid != ? ORDER BY rowid LIMIT 1` — queried siblings sharing same session_id, not parent
bug1.new: `SELECT rowid, uid, content, name, summary, importance, t_created, t_valid, t_invalid, agent_id, content_hash FROM node WHERE uid = ?` — looks up parent by UID (currentNode.session_id is the parent's UID)

bug2.old: `if (parentDocRow) { currentRowid = parentDocRow.rowid; continue; }` — skipped source text extraction, token estimation, overflow check, and sources array push
bug2.new: Full source-addition block: extract parentText from content/name/summary, estimateTokens, overflow check with ExpansionOverflowError or truncate-tail break, push to sources, increment expandedTokens, then set currentRowid and continue

verification.test: passed — 9 test files, 159 passed, 1 skipped (npx nx test memory-core)
verification.lint: passed — all files pass (npx nx lint memory-core)

handoff.notes: No regressions. The fix is purely within the parent-context fallback branch that fires when DERIVED_FROM edges are absent. All existing tests continue to pass, and the runtime behavior now correctly adds parent document content to sources with proper token budget accounting.
